name: LayerAlphaCopy
summary: First step of a layer's drop shadow: copies the layer alpha into RT3_EffectAlpha inside the layer's atlas rectangle.

behavior.basis: (live read of the selector's program table, 2026-10-29)
behavior.text: program 0 = shader objects of VS 034080 and PS 0349C0.

name: LayerBlit
summary: The layer blit: draws one layer's quad (rect - atlas offset) with the layer blend type as selector digit 0 and the offset-vector flag as digit 1. The pixel shader writes the frame target through a UAV; the fixed-function blend word GUILayer_BlitFinal stores (0x78020011: enabled, ONE / ZERO) therefore only matters when a shader writes a render target output.

behavior.text: GUILayer_BlitFinal sets digit 0 = layer+32 (the blend type) and digit 1 = (any of the three offset vectors at layer+120.. is non-zero), applies program 0, then stores the blend word 2013397009 (0x78020011) at state+120 after the apply: enabled, source ONE, destination ZERO, add, alpha the same, write mask 0xF (decoded with the BlendDesc_FromWords field layout).
the shaders of blend type 0 write no render-target output (their outputs list is empty); they write only UAV u0.

open_questions: ? which of the 38 selector #9 programs a given blend type resolves to is inferred (see LayerBlendNormal_PS).

name: LayerShadow
summary: The drop-shadow draw: the layer quad moved by the offset, darkening the target under the blurred alpha.

behavior.text: the technique's default sampler words cover slots 13 and 16 only; slot 14 (g_Sampler, the shader's s0) keeps the default word.

name: UIImage
summary: Draws every textured UI image: program 0 of the UI technique (shader objects 1 and 10).

behavior.text: program 0 = shader objects (1, 10) = the first vertex and the first pixel shader of uirender.tec in file order (0x001300, 0x001E9C).
